Academic Interests

  • Thermal Infrared Perception

  • Robotics and Computer Vision

    • Underwater robotic monitoring and infrastructure inspection
  • Generative and Vision-Language Models
    • RGB-to-thermal image translation
    • Controllable visual-language prompting
    • Synthetic data generation for rare visual classes

Research Experience

  • 2023 - Present
    Underwater Robotic Monitoring of Floating Infrastructure
    Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport
    • Project Lead, RPM Robotics Lab
    • Led underwater perception modules for image dehazing, open-vocabulary object detection and segmentation, and vision-based image mosaicing.
    • Conducted tank and at-sea trials with underwater robots in collaboration with POSTECH.
    • Developing a training-free method for biofouling segmentation in underwater infrastructure imagery.
  • 2023 - Present
    Thermal Imaging for Smart Construction Environments
    Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport
    • Graduate Student Research Assistant, RPM Robotics Lab
    • Developed a state-of-the-art thermal object detection system for construction-site monitoring.
    • Developing a VLM-based segmentation module for building crack segmentation from thermal imagery.
  • 2025
    Thermal Image-Based Navigation and Shipyard Monitoring
    Samsung Heavy Industries
    • Project Lead, RPM Robotics Lab
    • Led a synthetic data generation pipeline and real-time thermal object detector for rare shipyard object classes.
    • Optimized detection of workers, transport vehicles, and unknown obstacles for day-and-night operation.
  • 2020 - 2021
    AI-Based Safety Monitoring in Residential and Industrial Environments
    Electronics and Telecommunications Research Institute (ETRI)
    • Graduate Student Research Assistant, KAIST TCL
    • Collected and managed multimodal safety-monitoring datasets, including thermal infant burn-injury data and IMU safety-harness data.
    • Obtained Institutional Review Board approval for both data-collection protocols.
    • Developed thermal adult and infant detection algorithms and IMU-based safety-harness monitoring methods.
